release_scope: Person Profile + Editing Audit History + Protected Robert J. Loper Legacy Number UI
implemented: Full working person profile over the current Phase 3 genealogy data foundation
Prominent protected Robert J. Loper Legacy Number display separate from internal Person ID
Edit workflow for names, birth date, death date, living status, and primary family branch
Audit history display with actor, timestamp, summary, previous JSON, and new JSON
Parent and child relationship display with direct profile navigation
Person workspace links into existing tree, archive, health, military, cemetery, geography, and research modules
Update command auditing with previous and new values
Normal edit request intentionally excludes LegacyNumber
Automated tests proving normal person editing cannot change the protected Legacy Number
Dedicated Windows cloud build and single-EXE installer workflow
preservation_guarantees: Legacy Number remains stored as exact historical text
Legacy Number is not used as the database primary key
Normal person editing cannot submit or replace a Legacy Number
Existing Legacy Number values are included in audit snapshots without normalization
No destructive genealogy database migration is required for this update
not_claimed_complete_in_this_release: Relationship editing UI beyond current parent-child display
